title: MoVa: Towards Generalizable Classification of Human Morals and Values
reasoning: The paper presents MoVa, a benchmark suite for the classification of human morals and values based on four theoretical frameworks: Moral Foundations Theory, Human Values, Morality-as-Cooperation, and Common Morality. It specifically evaluates how Large Language Models (LLMs) can be used to identify these ethical and moral constructs in text.
